name: Amazon Athena
summary: Run Athena queries over data in S3 and register staged Parquet partitions in Athena tables. Registration is idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

auth.label: IAM role of the daemon host

settings.name: database
settings.label: Database
settings.help: A database in the Glue Data Catalog.

settings.name: results_bucket
settings.label: Results bucket
settings.help: Bucket for query results, unless the workgroup sets its own location.

operators.summary: Run a query and keep the result as Parquet.
Register staged Parquet as a table partition with ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION, once per partition and revision.

notes: Athena reads and writes S3 itself; the data lives in the bucket that the Amazon S3 connector publishes to. Add that connector's domains to the same egress approval. The table must already exist.
